title: v1_119
content: # Visual Studio Code 1.119 Follow us on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/vs-code), [X](https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?LinkID=533687), [Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/vscode.dev) --- _Release date: May 6, 2026_ **Update 1.119.1**: The update addresses these [security issues](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aclosed+milestone%3A1.119.1). --- Welcome to the 1.119 release of Visual Studio Code. This release focuses on smoother agent interactions, enhanced observability, and more efficient trust and security controls. * [Agent-browser interaction](#sharing-browser-tabs-with-agents): Let agents discover and ask for integrated browser access. * [Optimized token usage](#optimized-token-usage-for-managing-todo-lists-experimental): Use a lightweight model to manage agent todo lists. * [OpenTelemetry tracing](#opentelemetry-tracing-for-agent-sessions): Monitor agent sessions with OpenTelemetry. * [Trust and developer efficiency](#trust-and-security): Get less interrupted by requests for network access or temp folder writes. * [Markdown preview](#swap-current-editor-to-markdown-preview): Quickly switch between Markdown source and preview. Happy Coding! ---
